dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of PSV-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on PSV-7102 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7102 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically dissipating trapped and residual energy. PSV-7102 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during shift handover while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 April 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
